findings.fix: A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The sheet dealt Panchang and Switzer, but the page renders ui-sans-serif, Anton.
findings.fix: Load the dealt face (the link on the sheet) and put it first in font-family. A build that falls back to a default face lands on the default look.

findings.message: 2 section(s) have content at both edges and 7257px of nothing between: article.h-[100svh].w-full; "ELIXIR"
findings.fix: Bring the two parts together on the grid, or put the picture or figure of the section in the middle. An empty middle third reads as a hole, the same as an empty half.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "GHAZY FAWAZ HAKIM — SOFTWARE ENGINEER, BANDUNG" (screen 5, 45% over a picture); "SATU ORANG." (screen 8, 16% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 5 screens in a row: "GHAZY FAWAZ HAKIM — SOFTWARE ENGINEER, BANDUNG"; "SATU ORANG."
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.
